title: About me
text:
I’m Louis Maughan, and football has been the constant in my life for as long as I can remember. I’ve spent years watching it, talking about it and playing it as an amateur, and somewhere along the way I started wondering what the numbers could tell us that our eyes and arguments in the pub couldn’t.
That curiosity is why I’m now studying for an MSc in Data Analytics in Football, and why I’m making a career change into the game’s analytics side.

title: Welcome: why I’m learning football analytics in public
text:
I’ve loved football for as long as I can remember. I’ve watched it, argued about it and played it as an amateur, and at some point I started to wonder what the data could add to all of that.
Now I’m studying for an MSc in Data Analytics in Football, and I’m aiming to turn that curiosity into a career. This site is where I’ll show my working.

What I do
My main interests are opposition analysis, scouting analysis and predictive modeling using expected goals. I use Python and Power BI to ask practical questions about the game: who should a club look at, how does a team really play, and what should a coach take from the next match.
